name: Nyao
source:
Kou and Homuha’s homeroom and English teacher from an ambiguous Southeast Asian country.  She is constantly slacking off during class and she may or may not actually know English. Despite this, she is very dependable when things get tough and will always lend a helping hand. Her hobby is making jokes about genitalia.

[From [url=http://homuha.weebly.com/]official site[/url]]
